records.name: Penn Masti
records.summary: A South Asian fusion dance team at Penn with dancers of all genders. Members rehearse fusion routines, perform on campus, and compete.
records.what_you_do: Dancers learn and perform fusion pieces and take part in competitions. The club posts audition news on its Instagram and Facebook pages.

first_step.how: Fill out the club's application, then come to the audition. Watch the club's social pages for audition dates, or email the officers with questions.
first_step.basis: An application and an audition are both needed before you know what the group is like.

records.notes: Directory accepts members but lists no dated club event. The only dated item is a fall activities fair (Aug 29 to 31) with no year written. Officer emails on the directory were left out.

records.name: Penn Medicine Symphony Orchestra
records.summary: An orchestra for people who study or work in health care, with players at every skill level. It rehearses and performs as a community music group.
records.what_you_do: Play in the orchestra. String players need no audition, and some wind sections may need a short video audition. The join page says healthcare workers, including physicians, nurses and hospital staff, can join.

first_step.how: Fill out the interest form on the orchestra's join page. Strings can start without an audition.
first_step.basis: Strings need no audition and all skill levels are welcome, but some wind sections may need a short video audition.

records.notes: Directory email shows as Hidden, so the email from the join page is used. The join page lists physicians, nurses and hospital staff as members, not only Penn students, but the directory frames the group as a student club, so open_to is students. A reviewer may want to set it to public. No dated events or last-updated date were found.

records.name: Penn Reading Initiative
records.summary: Penn students who tutor second and third graders one on one at West Philadelphia elementary schools. The group uses a set reading curriculum to build reading skills.
records.what_you_do: Tutors meet a child one on one and get training before they start. The group is a student-run program inside the Netter Center for Community Partnerships.

first_step.how: Fill out the fall semester sign-up form linked from the group's directory page. Tutor training is provided.
first_step.basis: The way in is a sign-up form. No audition or application is listed, and the group trains its tutors.

records.notes: The club site shows no dated news and no sign-up details. Its Get Involved page is linked but its content did not appear, so the sign-up step comes from the directory.

records.name: Penn Sailing Team

schedule.text: Practices on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, from about 3:30 to 7:15 pm

first_step.how: Email the team through its website to ask about joining. Beginners can join if they can commit to the whole season and there is room.
first_step.basis: The directory says the team is not taking members now. The way in is an email, and newcomers are accepted only with space.

records.notes: HELD BACK ON PURPOSE. The directory marks this club inactive and not accepting members, so under the inactive rule status is unknown and no summary, categories or interests were written. But the team's own site lists competitions dated Oct 10 to Oct 31, 2026, plus Spring 2026 rankings. A reviewer should confirm with the team and, if the directory flag is stale, promote this to active and add a summary, categories (water-rowing) and interest (sailing). The coach's personal university address on the directory and the team site was left out.

records.name: Penn Sargam
records.summary: A student group that plays South Asian fusion music, mixing classical Indian traditions with pop, rock and jazz. Members perform in concerts and promote the music on campus.
records.what_you_do: Members perform as a group. To join, you audition with a 3 to 5 minute piece on your instrument or voice.

first_step.how: Fill out the club's interest form. The club contacts you when auditions open.
first_step.basis: An audition is required, and the club contacts people when auditions open.

records.notes: The club's own website (pennsargam.my.canva.site) returned HTTP 404, so only the directory entry was used. The directory gives audition dates of January 16 to 18 and also says Fall 2025, and the year of the January audition is not written. Folk_traditional_music is the nearest music tag for a fusion group.

records.name: Penn Singers Light Opera Company
records.summary: Penn's student musical theatre company. Students put on a full musical each fall and a light opera each spring, with singers, actors, orchestra players and a tech crew.
records.what_you_do: The group's site lists Sweeney Todd as its Fall 2026 production. Performers audition, orchestra players audition on their instrument, and tech members interview.

first_step.how: Book a performer audition slot through the sign-up page on the group's site. Tech members interview for their roles.
first_step.basis: Performers and orchestra players audition, and tech members interview. The group is a four year company, so most members audition once.

records.notes: The site's Fall '26 production has no month written, so no last_sign_of_life month is given. The directory's audition dates (Aug 29 to 31 and Sept 3) have no year. Left out: the orchestra manager's name and personal email, and the vice president's email.

records.name: Penn Ski and Snowboard Team
records.summary: Penn's ski and snowboard club team. Members take five or six weekend trips each winter to race and ski against other East Coast college teams.
records.what_you_do: The team covers racing and slopestyle. Trips take place across the winter, from January into February. Members pay team dues and sign the school and conference waivers.

schedule.text: Five or six weekend trips across the winter, from January into February

first_step.how: Register in person once a year, in late September of the fall semester. Pay team dues and sign the school and conference waivers. Registration for the current season is closed, and recruitment for 2026 to 2027 is coming soon.
first_step.basis: Registration happens once a year and needs dues and waivers, and the current season is closed.

records.notes: No ski or snowboard tag exists in the vocabulary, so outdoors-adventure and hiking are the nearest fit. The directory marks the club not accepting members and lists a personal university address as the contact, so the club's own upennski@gmail.com is used instead. The 2025 trip list has no exact dates.

records.name: Penn Undergraduate Biotech Society (PUBS)
records.summary: An undergraduate group for students interested in biotech, healthcare and business. Members join committees for pro bono consulting, finance, a biotech podcast and research.
records.what_you_do: Committee members work on pro bono consulting for biotech clients, market research and investment ideas, a podcast, and reviews of research. Any Penn undergraduate can join the general membership with no application.

first_step.how: Sign up for the general membership listserv through the group's site, which needs no application. Committee seats take a written application through Penn Labs, usually opening in August and January.
first_step.basis: General membership needs no application. Committee seats need a written application.

records.notes: The directory marks the club not accepting members, but the club's own site says general membership is open to all Penn undergrads with no application, so the site is used. Officer names and personal addresses on the site were left out. The site's footer year is not counted as evidence. The site says AI and policy committees launch in Fall 2026.

records.name: Penn Undergraduate Criminology Society (PUCS)
records.summary: Penn undergraduates who are curious about criminology can join this group, and no criminology major is needed. It holds faculty round tables and panels on internships and careers.
records.what_you_do: Members can attend any event they like, including faculty round tables, internship panels and career panels.

first_step.how: Fill out the sign-up form on the club's site to join its listserv and Slack. Then attend events when you can.
first_step.basis: Open to any Penn undergraduate with a sign-up form, and you can drop in on events.

records.notes: The club site's footer says 2021, which is not counted as evidence, and its pages show no dated posts. The directory's application field is yes, but no application process is described. The fall activities fair (Aug 29 to 31) has no year written.

records.name: PENNaach
records.summary: Penn dancers who blend South Asian styles into fusion routines. They compete, and each year they hold a February show of pieces they choreograph themselves.
records.what_you_do: Dancers and non-dancers can audition in the fall or spring. Members perform in competitions and in the February show.

first_step.how: Come to the fall or spring audition. Follow the club's Instagram for audition dates.
first_step.basis: Auditions are held each fall and spring, and no other joining steps are published.

records.notes: The lead blurb calls the troupe all-female, but the club's directory page did not say so, so no community tag was added. The application field shows 3 with no explanation. The club has no website of its own.

records.name: PennApps
records.summary: A student group that runs PennApps, a coding hackathon that started in 2009. Teams of students build software projects during the event.
records.what_you_do: The club plans the hackathon. Its site says applications open later in October, and you can leave your name there to be told when they open.

first_step.how: Apply when applications open, which the site says is later in October. Leave your name on the site to get an alert.
first_step.basis: An application is needed, and applications are not open right now.

records.notes: The site's current event is PennApps XXVII in the spring semester, with no year written. The site does not say whether the application is for hackathon participants or for club roles, so the wording follows the site. The directory says the club is not accepting members.

records.name: PennSori A Cappella
records.notes: HELD BACK ON PURPOSE. The directory page marks the club INACTIVE even though its accepting-members field says yes. The club's own site shows no dated news, events or recruiting notice, so status is unknown and no summary, categories or interests were written. A reviewer should confirm with the club, or drop the record. The site describes the group as a K-pop fusion a cappella group, while the directory says Korean and American.

records.name: Pennsylvania Players
records.summary: Penn's student theatre group, open to actors, singers, dancers, musicians, designers and stage crew. Each year it stages a fall musical and a spring drama, and it helps produce a winter one act festival.
records.what_you_do: Performers audition at the start of each semester. Tech and design members interview for crew roles. Students can work on the stage or behind it.

first_step.how: Come to the auditions at the start of a semester, or interview for a tech role. The group's site does not list a sign-up step.
first_step.basis: Performers audition and tech roles interview, and the way in is not written out on the site.

records.notes: The club's Weebly site has almost no text: no dates and no join steps. Its one link goes to a third-party page, which was not followed. The directory's audition dates (Sept 1 and 2, and Sept 7 and 8) have no year. Two chair emails on the directory were left out as personal.

records.name: Pennsylvania Six-5000 (Penn Six)
records.summary: Penn's co-ed comedy a cappella group, founded in 1980. It mixes songs from many genres with sketch comedy in its shows.
records.what_you_do: Members sing in the group's shows, which mix music and comedy. The group's site says there is no audition and no interview, and the directory says all experience levels are welcome.

first_step.how: Use the Join the Song call on the group's site, or email the group in the fall or spring for rehearsal details.
first_step.basis: The directory lists an application as required, but the group's site says there is no audition or interview. Ask the group which steps apply.

records.notes: The site lists a Fall 2025 show with no month, and a spring show with dates but no year. The founding year 1980 comes from the club's own site.

records.name: Penny Loafers A Cappella
records.summary: An all-gender indie-pop a cappella group at Penn. It sings popular and lesser-known songs and competes in the ICCA collegiate a cappella competition.
records.what_you_do: Members rehearse three times a week, then perform at gigs, winter and spring concerts, and ICCA competitions.

schedule.text: Three rehearsals per week, plus gigs and concerts

first_step.how: Come to the open call auditions, then the callbacks.
first_step.basis: An open call audition and callbacks are required before you join.

records.notes: The site lists a Spring 2025 show, a 2025 album and 2024 ICCA results, none with months, so status is probably_active. The directory's application field shows 4 with no explanation. A phone number on the site was left out.

records.name: PennYo A Cappella
records.summary: Penn's Chinese a cappella group. It bills itself as the first Chinese a cappella group on a US college campus, and its members write many of its arrangements.
records.what_you_do: The group sings Chinese and Western music, performs shows and takes event bookings. Chinese is not required to join.

first_step.how: Fill out the interest form linked on the group's site, then come to the audition. Fall 2026 auditions are listed as upcoming.
first_step.basis: An audition is required, and the interest form comes first.

records.notes: The site's spring show dates (March 20 and 21) sit under a SPRING 2026 heading, so the year comes from that heading. The site also lists a 2025 album. Directory and site both say the group is accepting members.

records.name: People for Immigrant Rights
records.summary: A Penn student group run by undocumented young people and their allies. It holds talks and know your rights sessions and works for fair access to college and opportunities for immigrant students.
records.what_you_do: Go to events, email the group, follow it on Instagram, or join its listserv. The group also runs a scholarship fund.

first_step.how: Attend an event, email the group, or sign up for its listserv.
first_step.basis: Events and the listserv are open, and no application or audition is described.

records.notes: The site's newest dated post is Dec 3, 2025. It says not to use pennforimmigrantrights@gmail.com (marked inactive), so the club's general address is used. HIAS PA and TheDream.US appear in its news posts but were not followed.

records.name: Persian Students Association at Penn
records.summary: A student group that shares Persian culture on campus through social events, holiday celebrations and Farsi practice. It also gives Persian students at Penn a place to connect.
records.what_you_do: Join social events, cultural holiday celebrations and Farsi practice. The annual Nowruz festival each March is open to the Philadelphia public.

first_step.how: Email the group or follow its Instagram to hear about events. The group lists an application step, but does not describe it.
first_step.basis: An application is listed as required, but the steps are not explained, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The directory describes the group as a support group for Persians at Penn, but it is not marked as one, so support_group is false. The Nowruz date is only 'March' with no year. Persian is not in the heritage list, so no heritage tag was added. The club has no website of its own.

records.name: Peruvian Student Association
records.summary: Shares Peruvian traditions and culture with students from Peru, people of Peruvian descent, and anyone who wants to learn about the country's history.
records.what_you_do: Takes part in social and artistic events, and links students with alumni and the Peruvian community in Philadelphia.

first_step.how: Email peruatpenn@gmail.com or message the Instagram account to ask how to join. The directory says an application is required, but the steps are not published.
first_step.basis: An application is listed as required, and no joining steps are published.

records.notes: The club has no website. The directory says it accepts members, but no events or dates were found. The directory says it welcomes anyone interested and links to the Peruvian community in Philadelphia, but it does not clearly say non-Penn people may join, so open_to is students. Peru is not a heritage id in the vocabulary.

records.name: Phi Delta Epsilon
records.summary: An all-gender pre-medical fraternity at Penn. Members plan social, service and fundraising events and get career support for pre-med students.
records.what_you_do: Members take part in social, service and fundraising events, and in career development for students who plan to attend medical or osteopathic school.

first_step.how: Recruitment happens at the start of each semester. Visit upennphide.com or follow the club's Instagram for recruitment posts. Eligibility: undergraduates who intend to pursue an M.D. or D.O.
first_step.basis: The club recruits each semester, but the steps, dates and any dues are not shown in the text.

records.notes: No dated events on the site or in the directory. Fraternity dues and rush dates are not listed. The site has a Recruitment page, but its content did not appear.

blocked.note: Not found. The club's own site is gone, so only the directory entry was used for Penn Sargam.

notes: All 20 clubs in the batch were checked. Each got a directory fetch from the Penn Clubs API, and each club's own linked site was fetched once where one existed. 36 fetches used, 0 WebSearch calls, no rate limiting seen. Two records are held back on purpose (Penn Sailing Team and PennSori A Cappella): the directory marks both inactive, so under the inactive rule their status is unknown and no summary, categories or interests were written. Penn Sailing's own site shows Oct 2026 competitions, so a reviewer should decide whether to promote it. Personal emails, phone numbers and named officer contacts were left out of every record. Newcomer scores of 2 were given where the directory marks an application or audition as required, and the scores of 3 where the club's own site describes an open way in. Verdicts: 20 publish (2 of them held back by status unknown), 0 hide, 0 other. Status counts: 3 active (Penn Singers, PennYo, People for Immigrant Rights), 15 probably_active, 2 unknown (Penn Sailing and PennSori, both held back). Summaries were written in plain words, not copied from the sites.
